$comment: lcars-helm plugin configuration: local logging plus opportunistic upload to the cloud. Placeholders are replaced by deploy/provision.sh on the Pi and by scripts/setup-dev-signalk.mjs during development, exactly like venus.json. Leaving the cloud URL blank (provision.sh's default with no --cloud-url given) is a valid, supported configuration: the plugin still samples and writes the local NDJSON log, it just never has anywhere to upload it, and /plugins/lcars-helm/status reports vessel.state as 'unconfigured' rather than treating that as an error. The vessel's ECDSA key pair is generated on first start under this plugin's own data directory (plugin-config-data/lcars-helm/), not here — this file carries no secret.
